roles.name: junior-worker
roles.what: works one ticket to closed: writes the code, runs the criteria, starts its reviewer
roles.returns: events on its ticket, which the relay turns into wakes for the orchestrator

roles.name: senior-worker
roles.what: the worker of a ticket graded senior
roles.returns: events on its ticket, which the relay turns into wakes for the orchestrator

roles.name: reviewer
roles.what: reviews one ticket's diff, sending the code-review axes
roles.returns: reviewer.reported on the ticket, which the relay turns into a wake for its worker

roles.name: advisor
roles.what: a second opinion on one decision, on a stronger model
roles.returns: its answer, reported to the session that briefed it

roles.name: researcher
roles.what: reads one source, an angle of the code or one kind of evidence, answers one research ticket of a map, or answers one question the owner asked about the world outside the repository, and hands back cited findings
roles.returns: its findings, reported to the session that briefed it

roles.name: explainer
roles.what: turns researchers' findings into one explanation of how something works
roles.returns: the five-section explanation, reported to the session that briefed it

roles.name: synthesizer
roles.what: sorts findings into what was found, what is inferred and what is not known, and spot-checks citations
roles.returns: the answer in the synthesizer prompt's sections, reported to the session that briefed it

roles.name: code-review axis
roles.what: reviews one diff along one axis, against a ticket or the owner's request
roles.returns: that axis's report, to the session that ran code-review, in the same turn

roles.name: grilling fact-finder
roles.what: looks up one fact a question needs, in the files or with the tools, while the session asks the rest
roles.returns: the fact, to the session grilling the user, in the same turn

roles.name: ambiguity scanner
roles.what: reads a spec and its drafted tickets once and finds the decisions they leave missing or ambiguous
roles.returns: at most five questions, each with its options and a recommendation, to the session cutting the tickets, in the same turn

roles.name: architecture explorer
roles.what: walks the paths an architecture review scoped and notes where the code is hard to understand, change or test
roles.returns: at most ten friction points, each with its files, evidence and deletion-test result, to the session running the review, in the same turn

roles.name: artifact reducer
roles.what: loads one diagnostic artifact (a profile, a trace, a heap snapshot, a thread dump) into a form it can query and narrows it to the evidence of the cause
roles.returns: at most five findings, each with its numbers and the query that shows it, and what the artifact cannot show, to the session diagnosing, in the same turn

roles.name: interface designer
roles.what: designs one radically different interface for a module under one constraint it is given
roles.returns: the interface, a usage example, what it hides behind the seam, its dependency strategy and its trade-offs, to the session comparing the designs, in the same turn

roles.name: AGENTS.md surveyor
roles.what: reads one group's share of a repository and reports the facts an AGENTS.md needs, each with its evidence
roles.returns: one entry per fact in the survey prompt's format, or "nothing found", to the session writing the files, in the same turn
